notes: The first saying («يقوم في أمتي بعدي اثنا عشر أميراً») has its chain to Jabir ibn Samura, who heard the Prophet

The second part («فسألت القوم وسألت أبي ... فقال: قال: كلهم من قريش») is a second saying whose transmitter is the speaker's father, written without a name: rule 11 (two sayings in one report); not read as a route here
The first saying («يقوم في أمتي بعدي اثنا عشر أميراً») has its chain to Jabir ibn Samura, who heard the Prophet

The second part («فسألت القوم وسألت أبي ... فقال: قال: كلهم من قريش») is a second saying whose transmitter is the speaker's father, written without a name: rule 11 (two sayings in one report); not read as a route here
«ومن حديث» and «21 -» are leading words, left out; «سمعت رسول الله يقول» makes Jabir the last link, the Prophet ends the chain

«ثم تكلم بشيء لم أسمعه، قال: فسألت القوم وسألت أبي ... فقال: قال: كلهم من قريش» is a second statement after the first saying: the father who answers is not named as a link here; needs a ruling (two sayings in one report, second without a settled isnad)
